title: Four children playing Statue
description: Four children in a row facing the front, and the same four after the call STATUE with A facing away, B and C facing the front and D facing the side.

title: Full turn and half turn
labels: Full turn: back at the start
Half turn: facing the opposite way
The minute hand makes a full turn
description: Three panels: a ring with a complete circle for a full turn, a ring with a half-moon for a half turn, and a clock with the minute hand going round to where it started.

topic_name: Halves and Quarters Make a Full Turn
title: Half turn and quarter turns on the giant wheel
description: A giant wheel with its top seat marked E and three curved arrows, a half turn and two quarter turns, that bring the seat back to E, with 1/2 + 1/4 + 1/4 = 1 full turn written beside it.

title: Three practice hinges and the quarter-turn guide
description: Three practice hinges, P opening exactly to the quarter-turn guide, Q opening less and R opening more.

title: The paper fan at three places
description: A paper fan at three places: a quarter turn (right angle), less than a quarter turn (acute angle) and more than a quarter turn but less than a half turn (obtuse angle).

title: A half turn and then a quarter turn more
description: A fixed stick pointing right, a turning stick shown after a half turn and after a quarter turn more, with the swept three quarters of a circle shaded and 1/2 + 1/4 = 3/4 turn written beside it.

title: A circle in 8 equal parts and the straw
labels: 1 more part makes a full turn
description: A circle folded into 8 equal parts with the straw on A, turned 5 parts and then 2 more parts, and 5/8 + 2/8 = 7/8 written beside it.

title: A circle in 6 equal parts and one part folded in half
description: A circle in 6 equal parts with the first part split into two 1/12 parts, and three rows of 1/12 blocks showing 2, 4 and 6 pieces.

title: An angle covered by a 1/6 piece and a 1/12 piece
description: A right angle covered by a 1/6 piece and a 1/12 piece laid side by side, with 1/6 + 1/12 = 2/12 + 1/12 = 3/12 = 1/4 written beside it.

title: Drawing an angle of a half turn and a 1/12 turn more
description: A given line with a half-turn piece and a 1/12 piece laid after it, the second line drawn along the last edge, and 1/2 + 1/12 = 7/12 written beside it.

title: The minute hand from 2 to 7
description: A clock with the minute hand starting at 2 and stopping at 7, the five 1/12 steps between shaded, and 25 minutes = 5/12 turn written beside it.

title: An arrow turning from down to left
description: An arrow pointing down and then left after a quarter turn, beside a clock whose hand goes from 6 to 9 the way a clock moves, with the word clockwise below.

title: Padma turning 3 right angles anti-clockwise from West
description: A compass with the child starting at West and three anti-clockwise right-angle turns to South, East and North, with 3 right angles anti-clockwise = North written beside it.

title: The playground of turns
description: Six small scenes of the playground in two rows: a ring, a wheel, two straws, a disc, a clock and a compass, each with a short caption.
